actual_unbounded_or_conditional_edges.classification: Conditional filesystem-race limitation, not an unbounded normal retry. A tiny max+1 read hardening can close it if adopted; do not claim race-safe bytes without it.
actual_unbounded_or_conditional_edges.observation: Both stat-check size then call Path.read_bytes without an intrinsic max+1 reader. Under stable admitted files their content is bounded; concurrent growth between stat and read has no intrinsic read-byte ceiling until the full read/post-check.

actual_unbounded_or_conditional_edges.observation: LIMIT bounds event/row count; event byte check happens after SQLite materialization. Admitted fixed DB snapshot is finite, but hostile oversized SQL blobs or concurrent mutation are not universally memory/I/O bounded by JSON/artifact guards.

actual_unbounded_or_conditional_edges.classification: Keep existing byte checks and CPU/wall limits; no aggregate memory/startup certification inferred.
actual_unbounded_or_conditional_edges.observation: Raw transport bodies are finite; canonical serialization may expand escaped characters before artifact-size rejection. This has a finite input-derived expansion, but2MB raw input does not mean2MB transient serialization.

practical_IO_and_output_bound_analysis.conclusion: Existing parsers, fixed attempt counts, journal artifacts and exact finite owner snapshot give a practical application-level finite bound for the one-canary path under its admitted storage model. They do not establish64MiB aggregate application reads,32MiB all-owned writes or256KiB total console enforcement. No unlimited network retry or canary loop was found statically; actual resource feasibility still needs focused evidence.

finite_owner_and_journal_rereads.interpretation: Inherited verifier uses bounded event/row counts and fixed contracts; the frozen current prefix has1180events/194rows. Every owner operation may reverify and reread protocols/source/new proofs, so cumulative application reads can greatly exceed unique artifact bytes. There is no admitted unbounded dispatch/retry loop; repeated reads are finite but64MiB total is not presently enforced or demonstrated.
finite_owner_and_journal_rereads.native_SQL_note: SQLite uses native page reads/writes; per-JSON bounds do not bound whole-process physical I/O or SQLite/WAL bytes. Do not present an open-hook counter or journal-only sum as a universal bound.
finite_owner_and_journal_rereads.qualification: R01 exact dependency graph and one normal new-branch roundtrip must record actual repeated-read/resource behavior.
